decision: Implement a distinct REQUESTED_COUNT_V1 interface; never substitute requested caps for legacy realized-count inputs or retrofit historical checkpoint metadata

features.inputs: Exact outcome-free action_uid/scheme/h_request/m_request rows, common-fault count and graph SHA
features.normalization: Freeze entire caller-supplied roster and its maxima before selection; subsets use the same denominators
features.pins: Freeze binds graph, common count, roster and feature schema. Supplied hashes do not authenticate graph or external full-roster completeness
features.HF_M_zero: Numeric sentinel for absence of an M stage, not an observed M result

observation.join: run/action/attempt/stage/index plus exact frozen request hash; parent attempt and parent result SHA identify conditional prefixes
observation.controls: H/M PATTERN_LIMIT from frozen action; F explicit PATTERN_LIMIT, FULL or bounded decimal-string COVERAGE_PERCENT
observation.requested_and_realized: Keep requested control and generated pattern count separately, whether equal or different; equality is only a sample observation, never a semantic proof
observation.lineage: H then conditional M for HMF, F numbered probes; each F needs a fresh successful prefix under this conservative version. No cross-action prefix reuse
observation.process_identity: Strict host/boot/PID/start-ticks assertions with unique entity and common host/boot per run; not OS authentication
observation.failure: Failed actions cannot continue; unresolved exit/termination/elapsed blocks any later attempt. Missing elapsed remains null, not timeout imputation
observation.quality: Successful process is not D95 safety; threshold comparison uses declared common count only and never authenticates mapping/report bytes
observation.runtime: Summed caller-asserted elapsed intervals are not authenticated ATPG labels or end-to-end search cost
observation.validator_bound: At most 64 paired dictionaries is a parser limit, not a real attempt budget or execution authorization

checkpoint_policy.legacy_or_unknown_schema: Reject with CHECKPOINT_FEATURE_SCHEMA_MISMATCH, including same-length seven-value vectors
checkpoint_policy.exact_new_schema: Schema-ID comparison only, no body/weights/provenance authentication or inference permission
checkpoint_policy.new_training_required_if_no_legacy_equiv: A separately approved data/model version with actual request provenance is needed; this implementation does not authorize training or convert historical realized counts into requests

remaining_actual_gates: Authenticate executable/netlist/library/fault/graph and real request lineage
Bind and validate a real Tessent stage adapter with memory/time/output/session limits
Collect independently audited requested-count training data, not relabeled realized counts
Freeze model and full-roster orders under compatible schema before evaluation
